evals.name: bugfix-no-config
evals.prompt: I fixed that off-by-one in the date range helper we talked about — dateRange was dropping the end date even though the doc comment says inclusive. tests updated too. commit it
evals.expected_output: A single fix(range) commit with an imperative lowercase description mentioning the inclusive end date; body optional; no push.
assertions: At least one new commit was created
Every new commit header matches type(scope)!: description
Descriptions start lowercase and have no trailing period
Proposed message was shown for approval before committing (notes.md)
Exactly one commit was made
Type is fix
Scope reuses repo's existing 'range' scope
Working tree is clean (both staged files committed)

evals.name: commitlint-breaking-flag-rename
evals.prompt: renamed the --out flag to --output in the cli (and updated the readme). go ahead and commit the staged stuff
evals.expected_output: A commit that satisfies the repo's commitlint config (allowed type, scope required and in [api, cli, core], header <= 60 chars) and marks the breaking change with ! and/or a BREAKING CHANGE footer explaining migration.
assertions: At least one new commit was created
Every new commit header matches type(scope)!: description
Descriptions start lowercase and have no trailing period
Proposed message was shown for approval before committing (notes.md)
Type is in repo's type-enum
Scope present and in scope-enum [api, cli, core]
Header <= 60 chars (repo header-max-length)
Header marks breaking change with !
Has BREAKING CHANGE footer
Body/footer lines <= 100 chars

README typo fix in a separate docs commit
